niche: Money, economics and business history: how prices and inflation work, compound interest, famous company stories, financial psychology, economic history, scams and how markets work.
audience: English-speaking viewers, mostly in the US, aged 18-45, curious about how money and the economy really work.
tone: Sharp, clear and a little provocative. Short punchy sentences. Explain the mechanism, not the hype.
topic_ideas: Why a dollar buys less every year
How compound interest quietly builds wealth
The story of the Dutch tulip bubble
How a bank actually creates money
rules: Educational content only. Never recommend buying or selling any specific stock, crypto asset, fund or product.
Never predict prices, returns or the economy. No get-rich-quick framing and no guaranteed outcomes.
Only use numbers that are real and widely documented (historical dates, well-known figures); otherwise describe the mechanism without numbers.
Explain concepts and history; do not give personal financial, tax or legal advice.
description_footer: Educational content only. Not financial advice.
